intro h3d
apply not.intro
assume h : 3 ∣ n ^ 2 + 1
have h2 : 3 ∣ n ^ 2 + 1 := h
cases h2 with k hk
have h3 : n ^ 2 + 1 = 3 * k := hk
have h4 : n ^ 2 = 3 * k - 1 := by rw [h3]
have h5 : n ^ 2 ≡ -1 [MOD 3] := by rw [h4]; exact modEq_sub_modEq (modEq_of_divisible (3 * k)) (modEq_of_divisible 1)
have h6 : n ^ 2 ≡ 2 [MOD 3] := by rw [h5]; exact modEq_neg_modEq (modEq_of_divisible 1)
have h7 : n ≡ 0 [MOD 3] → n ^ 2 ≡ 0 [MOD 3] := by intro h8; rw [h8]; exact modEq_pow
have h9 : n ≡ 1 [MOD 3] → n ^ 2 ≡ 1 [MOD 3] := by intro h8; rw [h8]; exact modEq_pow
have h10 : n ≡ 2 [MOD 3] → n ^ 2 ≡ 1 [MOD 3] := by intro h8; rw [h8]; exact modEq_pow
obtain ⟨h11, h12⟩ := modEq_cases_mod_3 n
by_cases h13 : 3 ∣ n
{
  have h14 : n ^ 2 ≡ 0 [MOD 3] := by rw [h13]; exact modEq_pow
  contradiction h6 h14
}
{
  have h15 : n ≡ 1 [MOD 3] ∨ n ≡ 2 [MOD 3] := by rw [h13]; exact modEq_not_divisible
  obtain h16 | h17 := h15
  {
    have h18 : n ^ 2 ≡ 1 [MOD 3] := by rw [h16]; exact h9
    contradiction h6 h18
  }
  {
    have h19 : n ^ 2 ≡ 1 [MOD 3] := by rw [h17]; exact h10
    contradiction h6 h19
  }
}
